args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The export format is controlled by a React state variable initialized with a defaultFormat prop set to "csv" by default, so the format menu always resets to CSV on page load. To remember the last used format, this component should store and retrieve the format value in the browser, e.g., localStorage, instead of hardcoding the default.
